stage: Perception and explicitly mocked Challenge1 handoff; not manipulation acceptance
method_policy: Frozen R3 source and thresholds, source ROI and workspace_v1 unchanged; one separately versioned source_views_v1 camera pair frozen before capture. Reserved views opened only after interface/source/configuration freeze.
truth_isolation: Only this separate evaluator receives actual simulator IDs/roots/camera records, removal configuration, graph and annotations. Online inputs contain opaque frame IDs, RGB, axial depth, configured calibration, geometric class dimensions and declared source ROI.

references.positive: Highest remaining physical layer; full projected body-top face in frame and >=6/8 actual depth-visible stud samples within2mm. Includes isolated remnants.
references.excluded: One to five visible samples or clipped face: ambiguous; zero visible samples: not visible. Report counts, never absence credit.
references.controls: Physical-present references use original capture depth; NaN patch affects only sensor evidence, never removes physical bricks.
references.absence: Only removed current-layer slots bracketed by surviving material on both longitudinal sides and >=6/8 actual finite returns >=3mm below current body top. Removed endpoints and original missing extent are unknown. Whole-layer removal switches current cohort rather than creating30 absence refs.

matching.rule: Reuse unchanged one-to-one envelope IoU>=.5 max-cardinality then IoU; merge covering>=half2positive faces and their centers ineligibleTP. Existing duplicate/lower/ambiguous/outside/unresolved precedence retained.
matching.stages: Raw hypotheses, present declarations and joint present/missing/uncertain location assignments reported separately.

metric_eligibility.semantics: Initial integration consistency limits, not validated grasp/insertion tolerances, free6DOF/root-pose accuracy or gripper accessibility.

matching.report: All matched errors with N before metric gating; TP/miss/merge/duplicate/lower/wrong-height/unverified, uncertain/no_match, known-reference absence precision/coverage and unverified missing separately.

mock_handoff.rule: Fixture chosen from actual online PRESENT by public frame/candidate keys only. NoPRESENT => blocked; synthetic unit selftest does not count as observed integration. Unknown, missing, mismatched or nonpresent input abstains. Mock labels do not establish real classification correctness.

acceptance.positive: At least1 metric-eligible PRESENT per development state in >=1 of its2 views; every view and all coverage/errors still reported.
acceptance.negative: Zero noneligible/confident-unverified PRESENT, wrong/lower/height/ghost-target claims, wrong or unverified missing across both views and controls. AllNaN yields0confident present/missing; patch yields0missing.
acceptance.handoff: All4mock fixtures and4guard checks pass with exact actual PRESENT join; no simulator-identity/label fallback.
acceptance.failure: Zero eligibility is failure, not success by abstention. Baseline failure is reported without threshold changes or automatic implementation expansion.

limitations: Six development views are correlated static observations of one design.
Reserved geometry types were seen in prior experiments; this is held-out execution, not independent unseen-design generalization.
Ideal rendered depth, nominal configured calibration, shared ridge yaw/body-plane hypotheses; no physical or manipulation validation.
The final scene remains static initialized; native contact dynamics must be tested independently before extraction.
source_views_v1 is one separate post-baseline camera-scale experiment, not a camera search or physical wrist equivalence claim.
